subject: Northpoint YSA Ward Weekly Announcements
text:
All,

To Join the Ward Text List, please text your name and “please add me” to 770-470-3577

For those that would like to be a part of our unofficial NP Ward WhatsApp chat, you can join here https://chat.whatsapp.com/Iy62NkmeS5pKF2Wn05fbRr?s=cl&p=i&ilr=1

Aug. 31st (Monday)- FHE, 7pm at the Stake Center, Game Night

Aug. 31st (Monday)- Temple Appreciation Class (age 25-35) “Finding Christ through Temple Worship” 7:00pm Pizza, 7:30pm Discussion led by Jim Thorderson. Held at the Atlanta Temple Annex, 6449 Glenridge Drive NE (make sure to enter from Glenridge Rd. since the temple gates are closed on Mondays). See flyer attached.

Sept. 1st (Tuesday)- Institute "Connections" (see survey below) (age 18-35) “Come Follow Me for Young Adults”. 7:00pm Dinner, 7:30pm Discussion led by Karen Killebrew. Held at the Roswell Stake Center, 500 Norcross Street.

EVERYONE - Please take this 5-minute survey for Roswell Stake Young Single Adults: https://forms.gle/zxvyJAx2kxCkYiucA

We're exploring a new approach to Institute for Young Single Adults. We are proposing giving Institute a new name, "Connections". We want to create something that helps YSAs:
• connect with Jesus Christ
• connect with other people
• connect with their purpose and sense of belonging
Your perspective is especially important if you aren’t currently attending Institute. We genuinely want your honest opinions, so responses are completely anonymous.

Sept. 4th-5th- YSA Conference in Birmingham, Alabama, see attached flier for more information and how to register

Sep. 17th (Thursday)- Ward Temple Night, dinner will be held at the Temple Annex at 6:30pm, 7:30pm endowment session, sign up online, 8:00pm and 8:15pm baptisms, contact a member of the Temple and Family History Committee to reserve a spot

Sept. 26th (Saturday)- Ward Service Project, at the State Farm Arena, Million Meal Pack

As disciples of Christ, we're called to serve. Let's show up, show out, and make an impact by helping pack meals for those in need throughout our community. 🤝❤️ D'Andre McBride will be leading Shift 2 (10AM-11:30AM), see attached flier, contact D'Andre McBride with any questions, register using the link below:
https://registration.experientevent.com/showSTF261?bkgId=10&regGrpId=36

Sept. 26th (Saturday)- Fall Festival, 6pm-9pm at the Bothwell’s home (1040 Wilson Glen Dr., Roswell, GA), see flier for more details

Do you know your immigrant ancestors? Do you know how to identify them? There’s an article on the Stake website that will tell you how. https://sites.google.com/view/jcfamilyhistory/home

With family vacations nearly over and kids back in school this is the perfect time to preserve some of your family memories in FamilySearch. We invite you to take a few minutes to preserve your memories today. Don’t know how? Check out the Stake Family History website. https://sites.google.com/view/jcfamilyhistory/home

Help our Friends at North Fulton Community Charities

The NFCC Thrift Shop relies on community donations to continue providing essentials to help empower your neighbors. Your gently used items can make a meaningful difference for families in our community. Donations are accepted Monday through Saturday from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. at: 11270 Elkins Road, Roswell, GA 30076

Thank you for supporting the work of NFCC and helping extend care and dignity to others through your generosity.

This is a volunteer opportunity for individuals with Work Experience to share information about careers with NFCC clients. They are looking for people with experience in: Business: administrative assistant, Business: accounting, Trade: HVAC, Trade: Electrician, Trade: Welder

Just Serve NFCC Workforce Have need for 2 job coaches, one Spanish-speaking, one English or Spanish. An ideal coach has professional work experience and familiarity with applying for jobs, networking, and resume review. This is an ongoing volunteer position. Training is provided.
https://www.justserve.org/projects/7ba817fb-9b95-4a08-8283-1f3431536b3d

Join the Stake YSA–run dinner club FOOD WITH FRIENDS! Scan the barcode on the attached flier to sign up and find more details.

Additional Online Institutes are available at the link below
https://myinstitute.churchofjesuschrist.org

Please fill out your availability to sit in on a missionary lesson with our friends! We ask everyone to scan the attached QR code, which has been updated. Your involvement helps support the missionary efforts in our ward!

Attached to this email is the Ward Mission Plan along with ideas to apply the principles, and the Ward Temple and Family History Plan.

The ward has an employment specialist, Emerie Elkins! Please reach out to her with any job search questions or if you know of any employment opportunities. Her phone number is 937-657-8439 and her email is elkins_ea@yahoo.com.

The ward has a housing specialist, Hannah Gertson! Please reach out to her with any housing search questions or if you know of any available housing. Her phone number is 678-780-1758 and her email is hannahgertson@yahoo.com.
